subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Should this PR land only after Crabbox v0.38.1+ is published and verified through supported install channels, with maintainers accepting that older AWS worker installations will fail closed until upgraded?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but automation cannot authorize the coordinated dependency release or accept the intentional operator-visible upgrade boundary.

options.title: Publish dependency, then land
options.body: Release and verify Crabbox v0.38.1+ first, refresh proof on the current merge result, and then merge the fail-closed hardening.

options.title: Merge before dependency release
options.body: Merge immediately and explicitly accept that AWS cloud-worker provisioning may be unavailable for operators still receiving Crabbox v0.38.0.

options.title: Delay the fail-closed requirement
options.body: Hold or revise the PR until a different compatibility rollout is designed, accepting a longer period without the stronger admission guarantee.

recommendation.title: Publish dependency, then land
recommendation.body: Release and verify Crabbox v0.38.1+ first, refresh proof on the current merge result, and then merge the fail-closed hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature design, implementation series, proof, and companion Crabbox coordination all trace most directly to this owner.
